scenarios.instruction: At the exact candidate, run TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=7.0 /opt/venv/bin/python setup.py build_ext --inplace in flash-attention-v100. Then run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/flash-attention-v100 /opt/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_sm70_int8_block32_kv_cache.py tests/v1/test_int8_block32_kv_cache.py -q. Store logs in /workspace/iron-001-6d92c8c5/results/call3-native-build.log and call3-correctness-tests.log. Falsify representation, publication, page, bridge, grouped route, graph replay, and cache interface defects. Pass only if the build and all tests pass.

At the exact candidate, run PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/flash-attention-v100 /opt/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/attention/test_sm70_flash_v100_policy.py -q. Run source-native grouped partition probes for [0,1,9], [0,8,9], [0,8,16], [0,9,16], [1,8,15], and [0,8,15]. Run the source sparse-page graph probe. Store call3-policy-tests.log, call3-native-query-partition-probes.log, and call3-qsa-output.json. Falsify malformed acceptance, valid rejection, stale graph metadata, cross-request page reads, unsafe unsupported routing, or non-INT8 and Flash-Next behavior changes. Pass only if the policy suite passes, valid partitions succeed, malformed partitions fail, and direct and replay hashes equal the criterion oracle.

Use /workspace/iron-001-6d92c8c5/run-benchmark.sh at the exact candidate. Run int8_block32 and fp8_e5m2 with TP4, B1 and B8, 8192 input tokens, 128 output tokens, deterministic prompts, matched graph policy, and route summaries. Use three repeats for B1 and candidate B8, and at least two repeats for control B8. Store call3-int8-b1-i8192-o128-r3, call3-e5m2-b1-i8192-o128-r3, call3-int8-b8-i8192-o128-r3, and call3-e5m2-b8-i8192-o128-r2 JSON and logs. Falsify B1 round ratios above 1.25 or the B8 steady elapsed ratio above 1.15. Pass only if every run succeeds and every threshold passes.

Read exact-candidate B1 and B8 benchmark JSON and logs. Compare candidate and matched E5M2 GPU cache-token counts. Inspect each TP worker route summary, graph capture markers, module provenance, and JIT warning counts. Store call3-performance-capacity-summary.json. Falsify capacity below 95 percent, a missing grouped INT8 route, any grouped-verifier fallback, unmatched graph policy, changed module provenance, or asymmetric JIT contamination. Pass only if all checks meet the criterion oracle.

Use /workspace/iron-001-6d92c8c5/run-benchmark.sh at the exact candidate. Run int8_block32 with TP4, B1, 261632 input tokens, 128 output tokens, one measured repeat, production graph policy, and route summaries. Store call3-int8-b1-i261632-o128-r1 JSON and log. Falsify allocation, prefill, decode, graph, or output completion failure. Pass only if the run reports success and 128 output tokens.

At the exact candidate, run benchmarks/benchmark_sm70_dflash2_gsm8k.py twice with the fixed 16-case GSM8K slice, TP4, temperature zero, seed zero, request seed zero, zlab-shuffle42 order, 512 maximum tokens, and identical target and draft models. Use draft int8_block32 for call3-int8-gsm8k16 and matched FP16 draft KV for call3-fp16-gsm8k16. Record dataset, source, model, extension, and configuration hashes. Falsify quality regression or invalid answers. Pass only if both runs score 13 of 16 and both invalid-answer rates equal zero.

At the exact candidate, run git diff --check from d79724b49db425cb7ac8b5cfc4ca999ad3682f9a, Ruff check and format on changed Python, typos on changed text, changed-range clang-format on changed C and CUDA, and iron_scenarios.py lint benchmarks/iron_sm70_int8_block32_scenarios_v1.json. Build the native SM70 extension. Build the final wheel with uv. Install it without dependencies into a fresh target prefix. From outside the source tree, import vllm, vllm._C, flash_attn_v100, and its CUDA module. Store call3-static.log, call3-native-build.log, call3-wheel-build.log, call3-wheel-install.log, call3-wheel-import.log, and exact hashes. Pass only if every command passes and imports resolve from the independent installation.

From the fresh wheel target prefix and outside the source tree, run the TP4 B8 8192-input 128-output INT8 benchmark, sparse-page graph probe, and valid plus malformed native partition probes. Hash the wheel, installed extension, outputs, and logs. Verify the local HEAD, pod HEAD, immutable remote call-3 ref, candidate tree, worktree status, and index. Falsify source leakage, stale extension use, wrong route, graph mismatch, malformed partition acceptance, hash omission, unreachable candidate, or staged files. Pass only if the wheel selects the grouped route, matches the graph oracle, rejects all malformed partitions, hashes all evidence, resolves every identity to the exact candidate, and reports no staged files.

A fresh controller-independent attacker must inspect the full d79724b49db425cb7ac8b5cfc4ca999ad3682f9a-to-candidate diff, corpus, strict results, hashes, commands, logs, assumptions, exclusions, oracles, and exact remote reachability. The attacker must cover representation, scale publication and requantization, paging and reuse, malformed inputs, graph replay, fallback and compatibility, B1 and B8 latency, capacity and long context, quality, package isolation, provenance, stale evidence, and scope. Pass only if every declared family has a passing re-attack and no unresolved blocker remains. The attacker must return an iron-red-team-input-v2 document.

An assessor distinct from the controller and attacker must evaluate the complete strict scenario results and proposed red-team report set for the exact candidate. The assessor must test coverage, oracle quality, path classification, assurance breadth, safety floors, omissions, limitations, false claims, and required re-attacks. Pass only for verdict adequate with no uncovered acceptance-critical claim or required re-attack. Record blind spots and limitations. Preserve TP8, Flash-Next INT8, default INT8 enablement, and image promotion as exclusions. The assessor must return an iron-red-team-assessment-input-v1 document.
